column3: The production native discovery is the subject: it runs on a t.TempDir module of one package and must refuse a missing test; it cannot run through testenv.Go.
The production native discovery is the subject: each call lists a t.TempDir module of one package under build tags or held resource custody; it cannot run through testenv.Go.
The production native discovery is the subject: it lists a t.TempDir module of one package that has no tests and must refuse it; it cannot run through testenv.Go.
The production go gate is the subject: each call runs the go gate over a t.TempDir module of a few packages; it cannot run through testenv.Go.
